steps.name: Idea submitted
steps.description: Idea Box form response or Brand Manager email received.

steps.name: ATS1 Register idea submission
steps.description: Registers the idea in the Idea Log with the next free ID.
steps.rule: All 12 Idea Box fields present; next IDX-YYYY-nnn ID assigned; row written to the Idea Log.

steps.name: ATS2 Detect duplicate and related ideas
steps.description: Proposes Duplicate, Related or Variant links against the Idea Log, Tracker and Archive.
steps.input_contract: Idea record (structured JSON, 12 answers, submitter masked), taxonomy, top-15 candidates, up to 5 prior PM-I rulings.
steps.output_contract: Relation (Duplicate, Related, Variant, None), field-level evidence, similarity, confidence 0-1.
steps.fallback: Keyword search on flavour, format and benefit; PM-I checks manually

steps.name: Confirm duplicate and related links
steps.description: PM-I approves, rejects, modifies or escalates each proposed link.
steps.sla: 3 working days, before the Friday Idea Log close

steps.name: ATS3 Calculate weighted screening score
steps.description: Applies the fixed matrix weights to the eight criteria scores.
steps.rule: Weighted sum of eight criteria scored 1-10; score above 60 qualifies for the monthly Idea Screening meeting; Parked ideas get a review date.

steps.name: Idea Screening vote
steps.description: Monthly 90-minute meeting: attendees vote proceed, park or reject.
steps.sla: Monthly session; outcome sent to the submitter at once

steps.name: ATS4 Validate gate request and allocate ISC slot
steps.description: Checks lead time and slot capacity and allocates an ISC slot.
steps.rule: Request at least 3 weeks before the meeting; project, gate and decision sought stated; slots in request order; maximum 6 gates per meeting; overflow rolls to next month.

steps.name: ATS5 Check pack completeness and SOP version
steps.description: Checks template version, mandatory slides, 15-slide cap and seven sign-offs.
steps.rule: Template v3.2 for G0-G2 and v2.7 for G3-G5; all mandatory slides; main pack under 15 slides; seven functional sign-offs; flag OpCos on SOP v2.x.

steps.name: ATS7 Reconcile business case variances
steps.description: Runs the three SOP variance tests and routes breaches to the PM-I.
steps.rule: COGS variance above 5%; forecast vs G2 volume above 15%; spend vs budget above 10%.

steps.name: ATS9 Pre-screen recipe, claims and label copy
steps.description: Surfaces potential regulatory showstoppers per launch country. Never clears.
steps.input_contract: Recipe, nutrition values, claims, back-of-pack copy per country, country rule pack, registration flags.
steps.output_contract: Findings with rule ID and version, severity, excerpt; showstopper flag. Verdict words cleared, approved, compliant are forbidden.
steps.fallback: Mark not screened and open an RA case

steps.name: RA disposition per country
steps.description: Country RA Specialist records a disposition for every finding and every no-finding result.
steps.sla: Acknowledge in 2 working days; clear within 5 working days

steps.name: ATS6 Draft gate narrative
steps.description: Drafts the cited narrative slides for the gate pack.
steps.input_contract: Gate and template contract, ATS5 result, Tracker row, verified financials, ATS7 variances, functional evidence status, prior conditions.
steps.output_contract: Draft sections with inline citations, evidence-gap list, confidence per section.
steps.fallback: Section-by-section drafting, then PM-I drafts from the template

steps.name: Review and approve gate pack
steps.description: PM-I validates every claim against its source; Category VP pre-review follows.
steps.sla: Draft 8 working days before the gate; review done 5 working days before the meeting

steps.name: ATS10 Enforce gate prerequisites and release holds
steps.description: Releases the project to the ISC only when every prerequisite holds.
steps.rule: Seven sign-offs; correct template; RA disposition recorded; funding routed; all OpCo G3 passes before global G3; G4 at least 8 weeks before first shipment.

steps.name: Record ISC chair decision
steps.description: The ISC chair states Go, Go with conditions, Recycle or Kill; the secretariat enters it.

steps.name: ATS11 Record gate decision and update portfolio
steps.description: Writes the decision to the Tracker, files the records and issues the action log.
steps.rule: Decision and conditions written to the Tracker; pack, checklist and minutes filed to the gate folder; DocuSign at G2; Kill triggers a budget-release request.

steps.name: ATS12 Assemble G5 post-launch dataset
steps.description: Joins baselines locked at G2 with post-launch actuals into a variance table.
steps.rule: G5 due date and on-time flag from the launch date; variance table of SAP volume, market data, QA data and internal order spend against G2 baselines.

steps.name: ATS13 Synthesise post-launch review findings
steps.description: Drafts root causes, lessons and a continue, renovate or retire recommendation.
steps.input_contract: G2 baseline, ATS12 dataset, launch execution record, quality evidence, 3 to 5 comparable launches.
steps.output_contract: Findings with a cited data cell each, recommended action, confidence.
steps.fallback: PM-I and Innovation Finance Controller author the recommendation

steps.name: Approve post-launch review for ISC
steps.description: PM-I and BM approve; the Innovation Finance Controller verifies financial variances.
steps.sla: Within 5 working days of generation and before the G5 ISC slot

steps.name: Idea parked or rejected
steps.description: Outcome text sent to the submitter; review date set for Parked ideas.

steps.name: Project killed
steps.description: Budget-release notification sent to the Innovation Finance Controller.

steps.name: Post-launch review complete
steps.description: Review recorded and G5 scheduled with the ISC.

screens.title: Duplicate and related idea review
screens.purpose: Confirm, reject or re-link the agent-proposed matches for one new idea.
notes: Below 0.70 confidence the panel shows no label and the PM-I decides from the top-5 matches.
A rejected link needs an override reason code; it feeds the ATS2 eval set.

components.proposal: Link IDX-2026-041 to PRJ-0311 as Related: same flavour (yuzu) and benefit (zero sugar), different pack format (330 ml can vs 250 ml slim can).
evidence: PRJ-0311 Tracker row, Archive tab: killed at G1 for margin, not for consumer appeal.

No default clearance on SLA breach; escalation goes to the regional RA lead and the PM-I.

components.text: Hard stop: gate G2 for PRJ-0412 'Yuzu Zero 330' stays on hold until RA records a disposition for every launch country.

components.proposal: 2 potential showstoppers and 1 warning for Saudi Arabia. This is a pre-screen only. The agent cannot clear a product.
evidence: Caffeine 165 mg/L in frozen recipe v3 vs limit 150 mg/L (rules library GCC-CAF-004, checklist EMEA 2026.1).
Registration is required for GCC; the status is read from the RA tracker.

override_reasons: Documented regulatory reference required to dismiss a flag
